2.description: Your ship is attacked by pirates, corsairs or competitors. Gain an Enemy; if you survive, you lose all Benefits from this term.

3.description: A cargo deal collapses catastrophically, leaving you in debt. Your Benefit rolls from this term are forfeit and you must muster out.

4.description: You are caught up in a political or legal dispute that costs you your position. Gain a Rival and muster out.

5.description: Your ship is impounded, lost, or destroyed in a misjump. Gain one less Benefit roll this career.

3.description: Your ship is attacked. Roll Gun Combat 8+ or Gunner 8+ to escape; on failure, roll on the Mishap Table (not ejected). Either way, gain an Enemy.

4.description: You spend several years trading on the fringes of Imperial space. Gain one of Streetwise 1, Broker 1, Diplomat 1 or Carouse 1.

5.description: You make a lucrative deal. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

6.description: You travel extensively and broaden your horizons. Gain one of Language 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Astrogation 1 or Steward 1.

8.description: You strike a long-term cargo agreement with a major client. Gain an Ally and DM+1 to any one Benefit roll, or DM+2 to your next Advancement check.

9.description: You are pursued by creditors, authorities or pirates. Roll Pilot 8+ or Deception 8+; on success, gain a Contact among the Imperial Starport Authority. On failure, gain an Enemy and roll on the Mishap Table (not ejected).

10.description: You become well-known for your dealings on a particular route. Gain DM+2 to your next Advancement check.

11.description: You are entrusted with a particularly valuable or sensitive cargo. Either gain one level of Diplomat, Broker or Advocate, or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.

12.description: You pull off the deal of a lifetime. You are automatically promoted and gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.
